messages:
alex: Heads-up — ran into a 403 for images referenced from the runtime KV-cache guide (section: caching/images). Saw it in a customer repro and also the nightly link-checker flagged it: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#images

docs-bot: nightly-link-checker detected 1 broken asset in /runtime/kv-cache (image): s3://redwood-docs/runtime/kv-cache/diagram-cache.png -> 403 (checked at 2025-11-07T05:12:03Z)

sam: I can take a look, @alex. Is this a simple rehost to CDN or do we need to update the canonical url?

alex: @sam probably rehost. The image lives in the old staging bucket. Quick grep to find references:```rg "diagram-cache.png|kv-cache" -g "content/**"``` path that popped up for me: content/guides/runtime/kv-cache.md line ~124 (the img tag uses the s3 shortlink)

maria: If it's a rehost, let's prefer our assets CDN path (cdn.redwood.ai/docs/...). Also can we add a tiny alt-text fix while we're there? small PR with both change will be fine. Priority: P2, but customer hit makes it good to fast-track in the docs sprint today.

sam: OK will do a quick PR with rehost + alt-text. Will also run the local preview to ensure the image renders in staging. I'll open the PR and ping for review. ETA ~ 2 hours.

leo: Happy to review. I can do a quick CR around 14:00–15:00 PT. If you put "docs: kv-cache image rehost" in the title I'll grab it.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 - small sed replace + updated alt. Added a note in the PR about why rehost (staging bucket > CDN).

docs-bot: CI link-checker started for PR #8421 — running image upload checks and preview build

maria: Thanks @sam. Please also add a one-line changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md so the rollout notes capture the fix.

sam: Added changelog line and screenshot to the PR. pinging @leo for review when you have a minute.

leo: Reviewing now, looks good. Left one tiny nit about the markdown image title. Approving after that.

sam: Fixed nit and merged. Staging preview shows image OK. Closing the loop: file now points to https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/kv-cache/diagram-cache.png and alt text is "KV cache sequence diagram".

alex: Amazing — thanks all. Can we add a short runbook note under docs/ops/link-rot.md about rehosting flow (who to ping for CDN uploads)? I'll draft a one-paragraph and drop it in the docs sprint board.

maria: Good call. If you throw the draft in the PR I'll tidy wording.

alex: Will do. :thumbsup:
